title: Sandra K NDE 4560
content: My younger sister and I had been celebrating the birth of my cousin. We had been at a pizza and beer pub. We consumed a beer or two each, and then decided we should be getting home. I was almost twenty years old and my sister was seventeen, soon to be eighteen. It had been raining on and off throughout the day and it was starting to get dark out. Anyway, my sister had decided to show off her driving skills (which wasn't a good idea). I had told her that the Ford Torino that she was driving couldn't cut corners the way my Pinto station wagon could and she shouldn't try! I then preceded to tell her that she would lose control of the car in this rain. As I said those very words, she lost control of the car and it spun around slamming into a telephone pole! We were not more than five blocks from our home. My side of the car hit the telephone pole. Next thing I knew, my sister was calling out my name, 'Sandy, Sandy are you okay?' I could hear myself answering, 'YES, YES I'm okay.' But she kept calling out to me as if I wasn't answering. Finally, I looked up to see if she was okay. That's when I noticed I was hovering just above our bodies, about where the roof of the car was. I again answered my sister's cries but this time I could see myself knocked out with my head in my chest. I was outside my body long enough to realize that she couldn't hear me because I wasn't in my physical body therefore I had no vocal cords. What was weird though was I could hear my voice just as I did when I was in my body. What happened next was, since I couldn't reply to my sister's pleas, she reached over to shake me awake. When she did this, she let out this scream of pain (I watched this all happen). The next thing I know I'm somehow back in my body again. I immediately woke up and got out of the car to help her. Her collarbone was broken in the crash and she needed me! I didn't remember this experience right away. I believe the reason I have to come back to life is that my physical body wasn't broken beyond repair. Therefore, I got to return to it. One thing has changed in my life, and that is, I now have to some degree psychic abilities. Not real in-depth abilities, nevertheless true premonition abilities and a few others. I took two hours of ESP testing and I scored in the 96-98% in these test scores. I took these tests twice and scored the same each time! Now I don't run around telling people that I have these abilities, at first I was afraid of them. I didn't want to see ghosts or see murders and stuff, so I tried not to delve into it to much. I also can now understand how ghosts feel. We can't see them or hear them for the most part but it's probably the same as when I was out of body, I was talking to my sister and she heard nothing. It must be terribly frustrating for them. Anyway, this is my story I hope you enjoy and learn from it!

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She believes she returned because her physical body "wasn't broken beyond repair."
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She reports being "somehow back in my body again" after observing her sister shake her and scream in pain.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience consisted mainly of an out-of-body observation at the crash scene followed by a return to the body; no tunnel/light/life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports hearing herself answer her sister while out of body, then realizing her sister could not hear because she had no vocal cords; she compares this to how "ghosts" might feel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I noticed I was hovering just above our bodies, about where the roof of the car was.”
